headline: Approved $60,365 lead abatement at 6 Davis St, a $55,400 pickup truck, a $25,475 trailer, and a metering contract with EJ Prescott.
summary: Officials asked that their concerns about the EJP contract and a possible FY28 LCIP request for the remaining meters be recorded. Councilor Nagine abstained from the metering vote. A Bates College student recommended that City Council adopt a Payment In Lieu Of Taxes (PILOT) policy, and officials asked him to draft one for review.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 28, 2026 meeting, 4-0.
Approved the award of bid 2026-054 for a 1-ton 4x4 pickup truck to O’Connor Auto Park at $55,400, 4-0.
Approved the award of bid 2026-055 for an enclosed contractor trailer to Connecticut Trailers at $25,475, 4-0.
Approved the award of bid 2026-056 for lead abatement at 6 Davis St to Renovate Right at $60,365, 4-0.
Approved a waiver of competition to accept EJ Prescott’s proposal for the Kamstrup metering program, 4-0, with Councilor Nagine abstaining.
Requested that a student draft a proposed PILOT policy for future review and possible City Council adoption.

plain_text:
FINANCE COMMITTEE 
Lewiston, ME 
Minutes of  
October 19, 2026 
 
PRESENT: Chairman Chittim, Councilor Nagine, Ms. McCabe, and Ms. Hoskins  
 
ABSENT: Mr. Bouh 
 
OTHERS PRESENT: Deputy Director of Budget and Purchasing, Allen Ward , Deputy Public 
Works Deputy Director, Erica Kidd, Fleet Superintendent, Phil Brienza , Acting Director of  
Economic Development, John Blais, and Bates student, Theo Capeilleres 
  
The meeting was called to order at 5:30 p.m.  
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(149-2026) To approve the minutes of the previous meeting dated September 28, 2026, and to 
accept and place them on file by the Clerk. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(150-2026) To award bid 2026-054 for one (1) 1-ton 4x4 pickup truck for the PW, Water Division 
to O’Connor Auto Park, Augusta, ME, at their bid price of $55,400, including the optional 
extended cab. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(151-2026) To award bid 2026 -055 for an enclosed contractor trailer for Public Works to 
Connecticut Trailers, Bolton, CT, at their bid price of $25,475, including the option al installation 
of backup lights. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Chairman Chittin, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(152-2026) To award bid 2026 -056 for the Lead Abatement of 6 Davis St to Renovate Right, 
Wales, ME, at their bid price of $60,365, including the rehab program-provided $4,500 owner 
match. 
 
VOTE: 4-0
FINANCE COMMITTEE                                                                                  October 19, 2026 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Chairman Chittim, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(153-2026) To authorize a Waiver of Competition to accept EJ Prescott’s proposal to switch to the 
Kamstrup metering program, including leak detection services for purchases within the $500,000 
FY27 funding limit. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
Councilor Nagine Abstained 
 
The committee requested the minutes reflect their concerns for the EJP contract and potential 
commitment to a FY28 LCIP request for the purchase of the remaining meters. 
 
In Other Business, Bates COllege student, Theo Capeilleres, presented a recommendation in 
support of City Council adopting a Payment In Lieu Of Taxes ( PILOT) Policy. The committee 
requested he draft a proposed PILOT policy for the Finance Committee's review and consideration 
for City Council to adopt at a later meeting. 
 
On motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Chairman Chittim, 
 
VOTED: 
To adjourn at 6:40 p.m.     
 
              ___________________________________ 
                                      Allen Ward 
                                                                    Clerk  
        Finance Committee
